seeds.name: Mirror from Potential
seeds.description: Absolute nothing cannot be, so pure potential splits into a + and a − that mirror each other. Everything after is the bookkeeping of that first split.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: The First Reading
seeds.description: Nothing persisted until one difference was read by another. The first act of reading turned a flicker into a fact.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Pair Rain
seeds.description: Potential nucleates ± pairs everywhere at a steady rate. The cosmos is the standoff between creation and annihilation.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: One Pair, Endless Echo
seeds.description: A single ± pair in an empty world, with A2 forbidding a return to nothing. All later structure descends from that one pair.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: The Refusal of Zero
seeds.description: Every time the world nearly empties, A2 pushes back. The universe is a long series of near-misses with nothing.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Prism Split
seeds.description: An undivided 'white' potential refracts into many distinct directions at its first boundary, like light through a prism.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Z3 charges condensing out of light: shares 'one undivided start splits into several distinct kinds'; no refraction geometry.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Sustaining Chain
seeds.description: Laws exist only while they keep being re-read. The first law was the first loop that re-read itself.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Records Before Matter
seeds.description: Records came first, and matter condensed where records agreed.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Light-born Memory
seeds.description: The first annihilation's light carried the first record. History is that light being absorbed.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Leaky Beginning
seeds.description: At first the proper-time leak erased records on resting matter, so only moving matter remembered.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Kibble quench
seeds.description: A symmetric hot field cools and chooses directions patch by patch, leaving defects at the seams (Kibble mechanism).
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Frozen Coin Flip
seeds.description: One biased flip at the start made one sign win, and the excess is everything we see.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Chirality Seed
seeds.description: The world began with net winding, a spin of the whole that never fully undoes.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Gauge Crystallization
seeds.description: The gauge field ordered before matter did, and matter inherited that order.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Broken Time Reversal
seeds.description: The first rule merged states and could not be undone; a reversible world would have no beginning.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Domain Wall Universe
seeds.description: Our region is one domain of a single sign, bounded by walls against the other sign.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Phase-Lock Genesis
seeds.description: Countless independent clocks locked phase; time began at the lock-in.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Lopsided Light
seeds.description: Light ran faster one way than the other, tilting where creation happened.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Sticky Symmetry
seeds.description: Short-range stickiness broke the sameness of space into droplets.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: It from Bit
seeds.description: Physics arises from yes/no answers (Wheeler). Here: presence/absence bits plus records.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Rule 110 Genesis
seeds.description: The universe is a universal computer started from a single cell.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Shortest Endless Program
seeds.description: The world began as the shortest program that never halts.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Shortest elementary CA rule that stays ACTIVE for T steps; 'never halts' is only checked up to T.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Error-Correcting Birth
seeds.description: Lasting matter is the codewords that noise could not erase.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Reversible Boot
seeds.description: The world booted as a reversible computer, so the past is fully recoverable in principle.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Gas of Bits
seeds.description: A random bitstring that mixes; any order is a rare leftover.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Copy Cascade
seeds.description: The first event was a copy, and everything since is copying with errors.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Complexity from Soup
seeds.description: Life-like rules on random soup make gliders: complexity from nothing in particular.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Replicator Dawn
seeds.description: Rules with natural replicators (HighLife) spawn copies of patterns.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Inflating Lattice
seeds.description: Space grew by inserting new points faster than signals could cross it.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Dimension by Survival
seeds.description: The number of dimensions was settled by which one let structure last; compare this 3D recipe with the same in 1D and 2D.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Closed Loop
seeds.description: The universe is a closed loop with nowhere to leave to; all lattices here are tori.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Knotted Origin
seeds.description: Particles are knots in a field, and the start was one great knot untying.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Two point defects (vortex, antivortex) in a 2D phase field that can untie by annihilating; no 3D knots.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Vortex Gas Genesis
seeds.description: Space began as a gas of whirlpools that annihilated into order.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Dimension Leak
seeds.description: Space began 1D and leaked into extra dimensions.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Matter starts on one line of a fixed 2D lattice; the dimension itself does not change.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Sierpinski Seed
seeds.description: One cell under an additive rule unfolds a fractal; the start contained the whole pattern.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Boundary First
seeds.description: The edge came before the bulk, and the inside is a projection of the boundary.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Expansion Freeze-out
seeds.description: Expansion outran annihilation, leaving relics that would otherwise have met.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Vacuum fluctuation
seeds.description: The universe as a fluctuation with zero net energy (Tryon 1973). Classical stand-in: pairs from an almost empty lattice.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Coherent Spark
seeds.description: A single amplitude spread like a wave; the classical world came later.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Decoherence Dawn
seeds.description: Time's arrow began when phases scrambled; the backwards run no longer returns.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Anderson Cradle
seeds.description: Disorder trapped the first wave in place long enough for anything to happen.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Entanglement Split
seeds.description: Everything was one entangled whole that split into partner pieces.
seeds.label: DEAD-END

seeds.name: Measurement First
seeds.description: The first measurement made the first fact.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Middle World
seeds.description: Just enough dephasing gives diffusion: a world between wave and particle.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Quantum Handoff
seeds.description: Coherent early, classical late: dephasing switched on as the world aged.
seeds.label: DEAD-END

seeds.name: No-boundary proposal
seeds.description: The beginning has no edge (Hartle–Hawking).
seeds.v3_mapping_note: No Euclidean path integral or geometry here; any lattice stand-in would misrepresent the idea.

seeds.name: Past Hypothesis
seeds.description: The universe began in an extremely low-entropy state, and the arrow follows from that.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Packed Gas
seeds.description: All the motion started in one dense blob, and entropy has risen ever since.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Hot Soup
seeds.description: Maximum disorder at the start, so there was nothing left to happen.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Boltzmann Bubble
seeds.description: Our ordered patch is a rare fluctuation in an equilibrium sea.
seeds.label: INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION

seeds.name: Cooling Clumps
seeds.description: A hot gas cooled and clumped.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Gravity from Uniform
seeds.description: A nearly uniform start with a 1/r pull grew structure.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Noisy Reversible
seeds.description: A little noise broke a reversible world's memory of its start.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Entropy Ratchet
seeds.description: Records ratcheted entropy upward, one reading at a time.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Cold Start
seeds.description: Born at near-zero temperature with sticky particles: frozen before anything could happen.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Big Bounce
seeds.description: A previous contraction rebounded into our expansion.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Conformal cycles
seeds.description: Each aeon's far future becomes the next one's big bang (Penrose).
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Shared feature: each aeon's late state is shrunk to seed the next; no conformal geometry.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Echo Universe
seeds.description: Run forward, then exactly backward: the start is recovered.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Phoenix Bits
seeds.description: Annihilated almost to nothing, refused by A2, and restarted from the last few.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Life Cycles
seeds.description: Patterns settle into oscillators: a universe as a repeating cycle.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Breathing Lattice
seeds.description: Space expands and contracts periodically.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Flip-Flop Rule
seeds.description: A rule that inverts every cell each step: a two-beat universe.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Chaos that Remembers
seeds.description: Reversible rule 30: chaotic, yet the start comes back exactly.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Steady state
seeds.description: Creation balances loss forever, with no beginning (Hoyle steady state, lattice version).
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Cosmological natural selection
seeds.description: Universes reproduce through black holes, and parameters are inherited (Smolin).
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Universes reproduce in proportion to clumping; no black holes.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Survivor Rules
seeds.description: Only rule sets that don't die fast count as universes. Use Sweep on cellular automata and count what survives.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Persistent Records Win
seeds.description: Universes whose records last outcompete the others.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Anthropic Filter
seeds.description: Only universes with clumps get observed. Sweep particle universes and look at the CLUMPS share.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Mutation Cascade
seeds.description: Rules mutate slightly each epoch.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Fittest Vacuum
seeds.description: Many vacua compete and the most stable one takes over.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Gauge Fitness
seeds.description: Gauge-coupled worlds order faster; compare with gauge off in A/B.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Expansion Lottery
seeds.description: Only fast-expanding regions keep relics; compare expansion on and off in A/B.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Binding Selection
seeds.description: Record binding selects coherent clusters.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Self-Consistency Seed
seeds.description: The only world that exists is the only consistent one.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Self-consistency as a state that returns to itself (closed history) on a 10-cell ring.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Sign Monoid Genesis
seeds.description: Arithmetic {−1, 0, +1} came first, and A2 struck 0 from the states. Compare ±1 with 0/1 in A/B.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Gödel Gap
seeds.description: The world began at an undecidable statement.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: 'Undecidable' approximated by 'still ACTIVE at both T/4 and T'.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Mathematical universe
seeds.description: Every consistent structure exists (Tegmark).
seeds.v3_mapping_note: 'Every structure exists' approximated by running every elementary rule.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Parity Law First
seeds.description: The first law was 'parity is conserved'.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Counting Begins
seeds.description: The first law was counting: nothing created, nothing destroyed.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Fixed-Point Universe
seeds.description: The world is a fixed point of its own rule, where nothing changes.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Permutation Seed
seeds.description: Particles are permutations, so order matters.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: First Cause Loop
seeds.description: The first cause is a loop that causes itself.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: A cause that causes itself approximated by a state on a closed loop.
seeds.note: No control in the locked protocol: descriptive only, not a card.

seeds.name: Participatory universe
seeds.description: Observers bring the past into being (Wheeler).
seeds.v3_mapping_note: Retroactive assignment of the past has no forward-dynamics toy.

seeds.name: Attention Origin
seeds.description: A focused region of reading made the first stable place.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Many Readers
seeds.description: Reality is what many records agree on.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Lone Reader
seeds.description: One record holder, with the rest unread.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Reading Speed Limit
seeds.description: Reading spreads at light speed, so the first reading defines a growing bubble.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Forgetful Cosmos
seeds.description: Unread things fade (D3), and the world thins to what is watched.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Observer Gas
seeds.description: Readers are gas particles that read whenever they collide.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Watching as Dephasing
seeds.description: Constant watching scrambles phases and turns a wave into a random walker.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Gatekeeper Records
seeds.description: Things annihilate only when their records agree.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Glitch Universe
seeds.description: The world began as one error in a perfect frozen state.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Explosive Seeds
seeds.description: A rule where every birth is easy and nothing survives (B2/S) makes a blob explode outward.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Two Clocks
seeds.description: Matter and records ran at different speeds at the start.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Negative Room
seeds.description: Space began with holes in it that later filled.
seeds.label: FAILED

seeds.name: Rain of Light
seeds.description: The start was pure light, and matter condensed out of it.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Day and Night
seeds.description: A world where on and off are perfectly symmetric (B3678/S34678).
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Majority Mirror
seeds.description: Each cell copies its local majority, so agreement freezes into domains.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Mixed Kingdom
seeds.description: A quantum walker lives inside a classical gas.
seeds.v3_mapping_note: One-way coupling only: classical walkers kick the quantum walker's phase; the classical part feels nothing.
seeds.label: DIFFERS

seeds.name: Hot Sticky Inflation
seeds.description: A hot dense start, sticky particles and expanding space: does structure survive the stretch?
seeds.label: DIFFERS
